text:
Carla (Sales): University AI Lab (nonprofit) asked for a one-time research discount + waiver of overage fees for the 90-day pilot. Need quick finance ok.
Elaine (Finance): Amount requested? Is this a policy exception or a system correction?
Carla (Sales): Policy exception. They're asking for $9,600 off the pilot invoice (one-off credit) and waiver of any usage overage charges for the pilot period. They commit to publish a joint case study if we approve.
Jordan (Acct Mgmt): Commercialsummary: 1) One-off credit $9,600 2) Overage fees waived for 90-day pilot only 3) Non-commercial partner clause, not a precedent for enterprise deals.
Elaine (Finance): $9.6k is below our manual CFO review threshold, finance ops can approve but requires Legal addendum and SF opp note. Need GL code and approver name.
Carla (Sales): GL 6230 - Partner Credits. Approver: Elaine (Finance). SF opp ID: 0112-UAI-PILOT.
Nora (Legal): I'll draft a short addendum: limited-term waiver of overages, one-off credit, publicity covenant (case study), and explicit non-precedent language. Will send to University counsel for signature.
Elaine (Finance): Approve contingent on signed addendum and documented ops ticket. We'll book as "partner research credit".
billing-bot: Policy note: manual credits require signed amendment and ticket TKT-5102.
Carla (Sales): Sent addendum to university counsel at 09:18.
Nora (Legal): Counsel signed and returned at 14:07. Uploaded signed PDF: https://drive.redwood/pilot-uailab/addendum-signed.pdf 
Elaine (Finance): Received. Approving one-off credit $9,600 to be posted to INV-2025-1102 as "partner research credit". Waiving overage fees for pilot term only. Posting approval to TKT-5102 and notifying AR.
billing-bot: Credit scheduled CRED-2025-009 applied to INV-2025-1102. Overage flags suppressed for pilot window 2025-04-01 to 2025-06-30.
Jordan (Acct Mgmt): Noted. I'll update SF opp 0112-UAI-PILOT and add clause reference for renewal paperwork.
Carla (Sales): Thanks team. Will coordinate the case study deliverables.
Elaine (Finance): Closing note: GL 6230, memo "one-off partner research credit - Univ AI Lab", marked non-precedent and archived in finance records.
Carla (Sales): Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
